GRAVITY AND THE STANDARD MODEL WITH NEUTRINO MIXING
ALI H. CHAMSEDDINE, ALAIN CONNES, AND MATILDE MARCOLLI
Abstract. We present an eﬀective uniﬁed theory based on noncommutative geometry for
the standard model with neutrino mixing, minimally coupled to gravity. The uniﬁcation is
based on the symplectic unitary group in Hilbert space and on the spectral action. It yields
all the detailed structure of the standard model with several predictions at uniﬁcation scale.

A noncommutative geometry is given by a representation theoretic datum of spectral nature.
